method: All 10 outfield defenders simulated from observed starting positions. Observed ball, attackers and goalkeeper prescribed. Fixed steps <=1/120 s with linear interpolation only between complete samples. No fitted parameters.
limitations: Three selected five-second windows from one match; transition-check evaluated after the correction was fixed, not used to choose it; neither free-play nor population validation
Roles are approximated from shirt numbers; speed, body orientation and intention are not measured
Position error is a trajectory discrepancy, not a tactical success score
Stationary reference keeps every defender at the initial position; it is a simple error baseline, not a tactical alternative
